thread:
Ravi K: Thanks for joining the all-hands Q&A — capturing follow-ups about the product roadmap sequencing for API / Console / Optimize. Putting answers and open items here.

Lena M: Quick summary: API GA-ish features focused on reliability (rate limiting, token accounting) shipped end of May; Console migration window for beta users mid-June; Optimize will start as a limited pilot in early July. I'll confirm exact calendar invites.

Tom: For the API release, does the rate-limit throttle change affect per-tenant token windows? We have a customer worried about bursty inference.

Lena M: Yes, the new windowing reduces burst allowance by default but introduces a burst buffer config for Dedicated customers. We'll expose the buffer setting in Console v2.

Priya: Console v2: are old API keys still valid? Migration path needed for integrations.

Product-Bot: Note: Console v2 introduces scoped API keys and deprecates global keys after a 90-day grace period. Migration guide draft: https://redwood.docs/console-v2-migrate (internal).

Tom: Scoped keys sound good. Need org-level role mapping for CI/CD pipelines. Who owns that mapping?

Lena M: DevEx will own the mapping docs and a small shim to convert global keys to scoped tokens for CI.

DevEx: Assigned: I'll post the shim repo and a migration checklist by Thu.

Ravi K: Optimize pilot — Samira, can you clarify what "limited" means? Number of customers/regions?

Samira: (was in all-hands) Limited = 3 pilot customers, US-only region to start, 3-week evaluation windows, with options to extend per customer feedback. Will need help with evals and metric collection.

Priya: Metric ask: we need token-level cost breakdown + latency histograms per model variant for Optimize to recommend quantization settings. Ops: is that instrumented?

Product-Bot: Telemetry note: per-token cost and per-model latency histograms are available in the infra trace pipeline; retention defaults to 30 days for pilot telemetry. Increase requests to infra@ if you need longer.

Tom: Two risks to call out: 1) Console RBAC gaps for service accounts, 2) API rate-limit regression on heavy seq2seq workloads — suggest we add targeted load tests.

Lena M: Agree. ACTIONS: DevEx to own service-account RBAC doc + shim; Ops to add seq2seq load tests to pre-canary; Product to publish final release dates by EOD Friday.

DevEx: Will post RBAC doc draft in this thread when ready.

Ravi K: Thanks all. I'll set a 30-min sync next Monday to review go/no-go criteria and confirm pilot customer list. If anything else comes up, drop it here and I'll loop in leads. :calendar:
